neighbours.label: the word 'fierce' / 'fiercely' / 'fiercest' (gate-closed)
fire: She is a fierce critic of the new law.

A fierce debate broke out in the council.
He has a fierce loyalty to his old team.
The two brothers argued fiercely about the farm.
It was the fiercest battle of the whole campaign.
Fierce competition drove prices down this year.
